There is also a safety aspect of using LocaToWeb. If you have the track running and something happens, your wife, husband and friends can see the exact location of where you are. Maybe you are riding your bike and falls off hitting your head, or you just want to be safe when walking home alone at night. 

Key features:

- Share your position to web in real time

- Capture and upload photos while tracking

- Just install and track, no registering is required
